strategy.offer: Modular programmable hardware modules, expansion boards, connectivity options, kits, accessories, and software bindings for sensing, control, communication, and prototyping.
strategy.customers: Developers, companies, schools, universities, and makers building measurement, automation, robotics, and embedded projects.
strategy.why_we_win: A building-block architecture combines modules transparently and makes hardware easy to control from many programming languages and connection types.
strategy.resources: In-house electronics, firmware, API generation, documentation, downloadable bindings, 3D models, and iterative product development.
strategy.direction: Expand the modular platform with new modules, richer software and firmware features, updated hardware generations, and broader supporting design resources.
